# Informative data for coordination among ICU4C, ICU4J, and ICU4X.
# Associates character properties with numeric values of property API constants.
#
# Format:
#
# property;value;number;apiName
#
# The property and value fields contain property names and property value names
# ("aliases" in Unicode Character Database parlance).
# Each name/alias is the short name/alias of the property,
# or the long one is no short one is defined.
#
# Most of these properties are Unicode properties.
# Some are ICU-specific properties.
#
# If the value field is empty, then the number is the numeric value of the property.
# Otherwise, it is the numeric value of the property's value.
#
# The apiName is the name of the ICU4C API constant.
# It is empty if the ICU4C API simply uses integer values (e.g., binary values & ccc).
#
# Values for binary properties are omitted.
# They use 0 for no/false and 1 for yes/true.
#
# The properties are grouped as in the ICU4C API,
# according to their property value types as reflected in ICU APIs.
